body.statement: For \(\mathcal P^*\), \(q^*=(1,2,3,4)/10\), \(\delta^*=1/4\), intervention \(do(B=0)\), and \(h^*(a)=a\), the sharp fiber is \(\Theta_{\delta^*}(\mathcal P^*,q^*)=[1/20,39/40]\). The lower and upper endpoints are attained by five response types with masses \((1,2,3,4,30)/40\), common-source selected-MAG legality, and intervention-specific selection probability one.
body.justification: The witness is an exact arithmetic regression test for both the formula and the graph-legality implementation.
body.gap: No named comparator reports this selected-law and selection-margin instance or its two attained response constructions.
body.consumer: Implementers can reject a compiler that returns anything other than \([1/20,39/40]\) or fails to recover endpoint SCMs.
